en.text: Behold, a day of the LORD comes, when your plunder will be divided within you.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的日子临近，你的财物必被抢掠，在你中间分散。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的日子臨近，你的財物必被搶掠，在你中間分散。

en.text: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city will be taken, the houses rifled, and the women ravished. Half of the city will go out into captivity, and the rest of the people will not be cut off from the city.

zhSimplified.text: 因为我必聚集万国与耶路撒冷争战，城必被攻取，房屋被抢夺，妇女被玷污，城中的民一半被掳去；剩下的民仍在城中，不致剪除。

zhTraditional.text: 因為我必聚集萬國與耶路撒冷爭戰，城必被攻取，房屋被搶奪，婦女被玷污，城中的民一半被擄去；剩下的民仍在城中，不致剪除。

en.text: Then the LORD will go out and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.

zhSimplified.text: 那时，耶和华必出去与那些国争战，好像从前争战一样。

zhTraditional.text: 那時，耶和華必出去與那些國爭戰，好像從前爭戰一樣。

en.text: His feet will stand in that day on the Mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem on the east; and the Mount of Olives will be split in two from east to west, making a very great valley. Half of the mountain will move toward the north, and half of it toward the south.

zhSimplified.text: 那日，他的脚必站在耶路撒冷前面朝东的橄榄山上。这山必从中间分裂，自东至西成为极大的谷。山的一半向北挪移，一半向南挪移。

zhTraditional.text: 那日，他的腳必站在耶路撒冷前面朝東的橄欖山上。這山必從中間分裂，自東至西成為極大的谷。山的一半向北挪移，一半向南挪移。

en.text: You shall flee by the valley of my mountains, for the valley of the mountains shall reach to Azel. Yes, you shall flee, just like you fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah. The LORD my God will come, and all the holy ones with you.

zhSimplified.text: 你们要从我山的谷中逃跑，因为山谷必延到亚萨。你们逃跑，必如犹大王乌西雅年间的人逃避大地震一样。耶和华—我的 神必降临，有一切圣者同来。

zhTraditional.text: 你們要從我山的谷中逃跑，因為山谷必延到亞薩。你們逃跑，必如猶大王烏西雅年間的人逃避大地震一樣。耶和華－我的上帝必降臨，有一切聖者同來。

en.text: It will happen in that day that there will not be light, cold, or frost.

zhSimplified.text: 那日，必没有光，三光必退缩。

zhTraditional.text: 那日，必沒有光，三光必退縮。

en.text: It will be a unique day which is known to the LORD—not day, and not night; but it will come to pass that at evening time there will be light.

zhSimplified.text: 那日，必是耶和华所知道的，不是白昼，也不是黑夜，到了晚上才有光明。

zhTraditional.text: 那日，必是耶和華所知道的，不是白晝，也不是黑夜，到了晚上才有光明。

en.text: It will happen in that day that living waters will go out from Jerusalem, half of them toward the eastern sea, and half of them toward the western sea. It will be so in summer and in winter.

zhSimplified.text: 那日，必有活水从耶路撒冷出来，一半往东海流，一半往西海流；冬夏都是如此。

zhTraditional.text: 那日，必有活水從耶路撒冷出來，一半往東海流，一半往西海流；冬夏都是如此。

en.text: The LORD will be King over all the earth. In that day the LORD will be one, and his name one.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华必作全地的王。那日耶和华必为独一无二的，他的名也是独一无二的。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華必作全地的王。那日耶和華必為獨一無二的，他的名也是獨一無二的。

en.text: All the land will be made like the Arabah, from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem; and she will be lifted up and will dwell in her place, from Benjamin’s gate to the place of the first gate, to the corner gate, and from the tower of Hananel to the king’s wine presses.

zhSimplified.text: 全地，从迦巴直到耶路撒冷南方的临门，要变为亚拉巴。耶路撒冷必仍居高位，就是从便雅悯门到第一门之处，又到角门，并从哈楠业楼，直到王的酒榨。

zhTraditional.text: 全地，從迦巴直到耶路撒冷南方的臨門，要變為亞拉巴。耶路撒冷必仍居高位，就是從便雅憫門到第一門之處，又到角門，並從哈楠業樓，直到王的酒醡。

en.text: Men will dwell therein, and there will be no more curse; but Jerusalem will dwell safely.

zhSimplified.text: 人必住在其中，不再有咒诅。耶路撒冷人必安然居住。

zhTraditional.text: 人必住在其中，不再有咒詛。耶路撒冷人必安然居住。

en.text: This will be the plague with which the LORD will strike all the peoples who have fought against Jerusalem: their flesh will consume away while they stand on their feet, and their eyes will consume away in their sockets, and their tongue will consume away in their mouth.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华用灾殃攻击那与耶路撒冷争战的列国人，必是这样：他们两脚站立的时候，肉必消没，眼在眶中干瘪，舌在口中溃烂。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華用災殃攻擊那與耶路撒冷爭戰的列國人，必是這樣：他們兩腳站立的時候，肉必消沒，眼在眶中乾癟，舌在口中潰爛。

en.text: It will happen in that day that a great panic from the LORD will be among them; and they will each seize the hand of his neighbor, and his hand will rise up against the hand of his neighbor.

zhSimplified.text: 那日，耶和华必使他们大大扰乱。他们各人彼此揪住，举手攻击。

zhTraditional.text: 那日，耶和華必使他們大大擾亂。他們各人彼此揪住，舉手攻擊。

en.text: Judah also will fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the surrounding nations will be gathered together: gold, silver, and clothing, in great abundance.

zhSimplified.text: 犹大也必在耶路撒冷争战。那时四围各国的财物，就是许多金银衣服，必被收聚。

zhTraditional.text: 猶大也必在耶路撒冷爭戰。那時四圍各國的財物，就是許多金銀衣服，必被收聚。

en.text: A plague like this will fall on the horse, on the mule, on the camel, on the donkey, and on all the animals that will be in those camps.

zhSimplified.text: 那临到马匹、骡子、骆驼、驴，和营中一切牲畜的灾殃是与那灾殃一般。

zhTraditional.text: 那臨到馬匹、騾子、駱駝、驢，和營中一切牲畜的災殃是與那災殃一般。

en.text: It will happen that everyone who is left of all the nations that came against Jerusalem will go up from year to year to worship the King, the LORD of Armies, and to keep the feast of booths.

zhSimplified.text: 所有来攻击耶路撒冷列国中剩下的人，必年年上来敬拜大君王—万军之耶和华，并守住棚节。

zhTraditional.text: 所有來攻擊耶路撒冷列國中剩下的人，必年年上來敬拜大君王－萬軍之耶和華，並守住棚節。

en.text: It will be that whoever of all the families of the earth doesn’t go up to Jerusalem to worship the King, the LORD of Armies, on them there will be no rain.

zhSimplified.text: 地上万族中，凡不上耶路撒冷敬拜大君王—万军之耶和华的，必无雨降在他们的地上。

zhTraditional.text: 地上萬族中，凡不上耶路撒冷敬拜大君王－萬軍之耶和華的，必無雨降在他們的地上。

en.text: If the family of Egypt doesn’t go up and doesn’t come, neither will it rain on them. This will be the plague with which the LORD will strike the nations that don’t go up to keep the feast of booths.

zhSimplified.text: 埃及族若不上来，雨也不降在他们的地上；凡不上来守住棚节的列国人，耶和华也必用这灾攻击他们。

zhTraditional.text: 埃及族若不上來，雨也不降在他們的地上；凡不上來守住棚節的列國人，耶和華也必用這災攻擊他們。

en.text: This will be the punishment of Egypt and the punishment of all the nations that don’t go up to keep the feast of booths.

zhSimplified.text: 这就是埃及的刑罚和那不上来守住棚节之列国的刑罚。

zhTraditional.text: 這就是埃及的刑罰和那不上來守住棚節之列國的刑罰。

en.text: In that day there will be inscribed on the bells of the horses, “HOLY TO THE LORD”; and the pots in the LORD’s house will be like the bowls before the altar.

zhSimplified.text: 当那日，马的铃铛上必有「归耶和华为圣」的这句话。耶和华殿内的锅必如祭坛前的碗一样。

zhTraditional.text: 當那日，馬的鈴鐺上必有「歸耶和華為聖」的這句話。耶和華殿內的鍋必如祭壇前的碗一樣。

en.text: Yes, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah will be holy to the LORD of Armies; and all those who sacrifice will come and take of them, and cook in them. In that day there will no longer be a Canaanite in the house of the LORD of Armies.

zhSimplified.text: 凡耶路撒冷和犹大的锅都必归万军之耶和华为圣。凡献祭的都必来取这锅，煮肉在其中。当那日，在万军之耶和华的殿中必不再有迦南人。

zhTraditional.text: 凡耶路撒冷和猶大的鍋都必歸萬軍之耶和華為聖。凡獻祭的都必來取這鍋，煮肉在其中。當那日，在萬軍之耶和華的殿中必不再有迦南人。
